project.title: Projects
project.description: Experiments that turn interests into tools: map components, image readers, and small products under steady iteration.
project.sveaflet_description: A lightweight Leaflet component library for Svelte developers, with a declarative map-building experience.
project.manga_description: A clean manga and image reading experience with multiple formats and custom layouts, keeping the focus on reading.
project.mini_program_description: A lightweight mini program that brings compression, format conversion, cropping, watermarking, ID photos, and collages into one place.
project.relic_description: In this 2D puzzle game, you take on the role of a cultural relic restorer and restore fragmented cultural relics.
